QuestInfo.name: The Boy Who Cried Kobold
QuestInfo.0: You made it to Stump Town. Talk to Chief Woodrock.
QuestInfo.1: Chief Woodrock says Bluffing Tom has been spreading false rumors. Better prove the chief wrong by hunting some #o9390939# monsters.

0.msg: Stump town takes your breath away with its beauty and peacefulness, doesn't it?

1.msg: Things may be peaceful now, but a great threat is coming!

2.msg: Bluffing Tom has been at it again, saying that those #o9390939# critters have appeared. You don't believe him do you? It's the same old song and dance!

3.msg: I'll prove that Tom is telling the truth! You'll believe me if I catch a #o9390939# or two, right?

4.msg: Sure. Good luck catching something that doesn't exist.

yes.0: If you want to prove that Bluffing Tom is right, be my guest! Nobody is going to stop you! Ha ha ha ha!

no.0: A rumor is only a rumor! Where there's smoke, there's fire...  Wait a second, that's not right...
